answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. An agent buys one slot by burning a 20-unit deposit, locked 20 epochs; its onyx seal and crystal record stay public for the lock's horizon. A verifier checks the seal before work. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 20 = 2000 units, no refund, far above one job's pay. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards because fakes cannot flood the pool.
